note: GET /table/snapshot?campaign_id= (1kg.7.2, ID-15): which campaign's table this principal reads. The campaign is in the URL's query because it is not a secret (SEC-43); the principal is the cookie (an account session or a screen grant), never a field of this query. A query is not a payload, so it carries no schema_version; the TableSnapshot that answers it does.

invalid.name: a participant in the query
invalid.why: a table principal is resolved from its cookie, never from request fields (eligibility ADR 4, threat model 8.2)

invalid.name: a grant in the query
invalid.why: the grant is the cookie; a URL is logged and cached, a cookie is neither

invalid.name: a slot in the query
invalid.why: which slots a device is entitled to is the server's answer, never a thing it asks for

invalid.name: no campaign
invalid.why: the campaign is the one thing the query names

invalid.name: a campaign that is not an id
invalid.why: an id is 1 to 64 URL-safe characters; a sentence is not one
